subject: Multi-cloud vendor onboarding: PO & invoicing mapping for AWS/Azure/GCP
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecorp.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-cloud vendor onboarding: PO & invoicing mapping for AWS/Azure/GCP

Hi Jenna / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — excited to get Acme listed across the cloud marketplaces. To unblock vendor setup on our side, could you confirm the following so we can produce a vendor packet that matches your PO/invoice expectations?

Quick asks:
- Legal billing entity & exact name to appear on invoices (for EU VAT).
- Preferred approach for purchase orders: single consolidated PO per month vs separate POs per marketplace (AWS / Azure / GCP).
- Do you require a separate PO for each cloud provider to reconcile marketplace fees, or will a single PO with line items be fine?
- Required tax forms for your AP team (W-9 / W-8 / EU VAT certificate).
- Any required invoice fields (PO number location, marketplace ID, cost center).

I’ve CC'd Vanessa (vendor ops) and Laura (marketplace enablement) — they’ll prepare a Redwood-side template and outline how we map billing lines by provider. We can also attach our recommended PO template and a short mapping doc.

Attachments: none on this mail (will follow).

Next step: if you can send the supplier questionnaire and your preferred PO template, I’ll route to Vanessa to draft the registration packet.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud vendor onboarding: PO & invoicing mapping for AWS/Azure/GCP

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear list. We prefer to keep invoicing as straightforward as possible for AP. A few notes:

- Acme AP prefers one invoice per marketplace per month (so three invoices total if you bill across AWS, Azure, GCP).
- We can accept a consolidated monthly PO per marketplace (i.e., one PO that covers all charges for AWS for the month). We cannot easily accept a single PO that covers all marketplaces by default.
- Required documents: EU VAT registration (for our EU entities) and supplier W-8/W-9 depending on entity. I’ll attach our supplier questionnaire and PO template for reference.
- Invoice requirements: include PO number, invoice period (YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD), marketplace identifier, and Tax/VAT number.

Attached: Acme_Supplier_Questionnaire_20280411.pdf, Acme_PO_Template_20280411.docx

If Redwood can provide a vendor packet with the three PO templates (one per marketplace) and a suggested invoice naming convention, we can fast-track account activation.

Regards,
Jenna Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
jenna.park@acmecorp.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecorp.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Multi-cloud vendor onboarding: PO & invoicing mapping for AWS/Azure/GCP

Vanessa / Laura — forwarding Acme's replies and their supplier questionnaire. Key points: they want one invoice per marketplace per month and prefer a separate PO per marketplace. They also require EU VAT docs.

Could you:
- Draft three PO templates (AWS / Azure / GCP) using our standard PO header and include suggested invoice naming (e.g., ACME-Redwood-AWS-YYYYMM).
- Confirm how we present marketplace fees vs service fees (marketplace passthrough vs Redwood billing).
- Prepare a vendor packet (vendor form + tax docs checklist + registration link) we can send to Acme.

I’ve attached their questionnaire here for your reference.

On Wed, 11 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700 Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecorp.com> wrote:
> Marcus —
> 
> Thanks for the clear list. We prefer to keep invoicing as straightforward as possible for AP. A few notes: ...
>
> Attached: Acme_Supplier_Questionnaire_20280411.pdf, Acme_PO_Template_20280411.docx

Thanks,
Marcus
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Multi-cloud vendor onboarding: PO & invoicing mapping for AWS/Azure/GCP

Thanks Marcus — looping Ben for tax/finops input. Quick take from vendor-ops:

- We can support one PO per marketplace. Operationally we recommend:
  - Master vendor record in our system for Acme.
  - Three active POs (AWS / Azure / GCP) tied to the same vendor ID; invoices can be submitted per marketplace monthly.
  - Each invoice must include the PO number (we'll create predictable PO numbers).

- Marketplace passthrough: for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace sale fees that are remitted by the marketplace, we’ll include a clear line on the invoice indicating "Marketplace fee (pass-through)" and the marketplace transaction ID where available.

- Tax handling: Ben — can you confirm whether we should provide a consolidated EU VAT certificate on the vendor packet or separate VAT numbers per legal entity? Also confirm if Redwood can ingest the Acme PO template fields as-is or if we need to map.

I’ll attach a draft Redwood_PO_Response_Template.docx and a short mapping sheet. Expect a finalized packet by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Response_Template.docx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-cloud vendor onboarding: PO & invoicing mapping for AWS/Azure/GCP

Vanessa / Marcus —

This works for us. We can accept the three-PO approach (one PO per marketplace). Next steps on our side:

- We will issue three standing POs once Redwood sends the vendor registration packet (please include the final PO number format and sample invoice).
- Attached is a link to our supplier portal where Redwood should register: https://procure.acmecorp.com/vendor-register (DocuSign flow follows).
- Tax docs: please include the EU VAT certificate and entity-level tax ID in the packet; our AP team will validate.

If you send the final packet and the three PO numbers, we’ll mark the listing as ready to move to marketplace activation.

Regards,
Jenna Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Attachments: Acme_Supplier_Questionnaire_20280411.pdf
